*Acoustic indices in response to bird assemblage and habitat metrics*

To investigate if acoustic indices relfect metrics of native/introduced bird assemblage, GLMER were used.

- Each acoustic index was modelled individually as response variable with one bird assemblage metric, the hard surface area and open herbaceaous cover as independant fixed effect. Site and commune considered as random effects. Models included the control fixed effect for the time (hour of the day to account for temporal autocorrelation.
